summary: This document updates RFC 7030 (Enrollment over Secure Transport) to clarify how an EST server can use the CSR Attributes response to specify both attribute OIDs and values, such as X.509 extension values, that it wants in a certificate request. It also updates RFC 9148.

eli5.summary: A form from the certificate office can say what to fill in and also give sample values. This clears up how that form works.
